steps.detail: Open the bread bag and remove two slices, placing them on the cutting board
steps.title: Take out two bread slices

steps.detail: Gather the top of the bread bag, twist it closed and secure it with the clip
steps.title: Close the bread bag

steps.detail: Pick up the Nutella jar and unscrew the lid to open it
steps.title: Open the Nutella jar

steps.detail: Turn to the counter and pick up a knife for spreading
steps.title: Get a knife

steps.detail: Scoop Nutella with the knife and spread it evenly on one side of one slice
steps.title: Spread Nutella on bread

steps.detail: Place the plain slice onto the spread slice and press to form a sandwich
steps.title: Assemble the sandwich

steps.detail: Use the knife to cut the assembled sandwich in half and separate the halves
steps.title: Cut sandwich in half

steps.detail: Place the lid back on the Nutella jar and screw it closed
steps.title: Close the Nutella jar
